# The CSD/4 topology catalogue, vendored for `scripts/csd4_coverage.py`

Byte copies of CIRISClient's `packaging/csd4/` (itself generated by its
`packaging/vendor_csd4.py` from CIRISServer#802), the key persist's testing,
QA and mutation scopes join to (docs/V60_TASK_PLAN.md §3b). TEST/REPORT
fixtures only: nothing at runtime reads them, and runtime vendoring waits for
the rc9 tag.

- Source: CIRISClient `main` at `ab134ef2ac60cf0960ca108beb3cd5764b84b144`
  (2026-10-21), `packaging/csd4/`, copied with `git show
  origin/main:packaging/csd4/<file>`.
- `PIN.md` sha256 `8264703422cca9891c5bd6d51ca0d08323b536e305b4c47c8aba64965525200e`.
  It pins the catalogue to CIRISServer `003871fd67c1215a0afe7da5a8eb523363562cb2`
  (PR #802, open, on no release) and the atom vocabulary to
  CIRISConstitution `01b47e75b2250742d8f603dae0142ce58cc86c40`
  (`manifests/topology_vocabulary.json`); catalogue_version 3, 110 atoms.
- Do not hand-edit. To refresh, copy the five files again from CIRISClient
  (after it re-pins), update the commit and the shas here, and re-run
  `python3 scripts/csd4_coverage.py --out docs/CSD4_COVERAGE_v<NN>.md`.
